text: I am planning a weekend getaway to the nearby mountain trails for a long-overdue biking trip. If Deborah happens to complain about eye strain from too much screen time during her trip planning, I should remind her to follow the 20-20-20 rule and look away from her monitor. Since my last ride with my neighbor was so refreshing, I want to rent a bike and spend a full Saturday exploring the scenic overlooks and breathing in the fresh air. I also want to schedule a quiet afternoon visiting the downtown modern art gallery that recently opened. Walking through the exhibits always makes me feel close to my mother and gives me plenty of inspiration for my own creative journaling. On Sunday, I will pack a simple picnic lunch to enjoy in the sculpture garden behind the museum before heading home. Afterwards, I plan to stop by the local farmers market to pick up fresh ingredients for a comforting Sunday dinner. This trip will give me a wonderful chance to recharge my energy, enjoy the simple things that bring me joy, and reflect on my personal goals for the upcoming month.
